subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should this issue remain scoped to the remaining durable replay/ack bug fixed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, with the operator drain/ack CLI request split into a separate product decision?
rationale: The bug path has an open candidate fix, but adding operator queue mutation commands changes public CLI behavior and needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Land bounded replay first
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the remaining bug fix and track operator drain/ack separately if still needed.

options.title: Expand the fix scope
options.body: Require the same workstream to include an operator inspect/drain/ack surface before this issue can close.

options.title: Close after lifecycle fix only
options.body: Treat the owner-lock fix as sufficient and leave durable replay/operator controls out of scope, accepting possible pending-replay follow-up reports.

recommendation.title: Land bounded replay first
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the remaining bug fix and track operator drain/ack separately if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged lifecycle stack and already commented with the current scope split between Bug 1 and Bug 2.
